subject: Vendor onboarding & payment path — W-9, PO vs card, next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@cascadehealth.com>, Jill Parker <jill.parker@cascadehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, May 30, 2027 at 3:05 PM PDT
Subject: Vendor onboarding & payment path — W-9, PO vs card, next steps

Hi Alex / Jill — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep procurement moving: 

- Procurement preference discussed: Cascade prefers PO-based billing for enterprise purchases; open to marketplace in parallel but it will take longer to enable.
- Docs requested by your team: completed vendor packet, current W-9/W-8 (attached), and banking details for ACH.
- Redwood accepts PO or card. If you route via PO, please send copy to invoices@redwood.com and cc Marissa (billing ops).
- Marketplace (AWS/GCP) is an option we can pursue — requires a separate onboarding window (~2–4 weeks).

Action items / owners:
1) Tessa — share vendor packet + W-9 and pre-filled instructions (attached). Deadline: today.
2) Alex / Jill — confirm payment path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and, if PO, provide PO template or expected fields.
3) Marissa — be ready to accept PO and route to Finance once we have the vendor packet.
4) Ben — available for technical questions about billing descriptors or product SKUs if procurement needs detail.

Attachments: [Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_v2.pdf (vendor packet, 1.2MB)], [Attachment: W-9_Redwood.pdf (W-9, 120KB)]

Proposed schedule: If we get the completed packet + PO by end of week, Finance can typically route vendor activation within 5–7 business days. If you prefer marketplace, flag and we’ll start the intake in parallel but expect a longer timeline.

Thanks — I’ll follow up here as items come in.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
---

From: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@cascadehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Jill Parker <jill.parker@cascadehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, May 30, 2027 at 4:12 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment path — W-9, PO vs card, next steps

Thanks Tessa — got it. Quick answers from procurement side: 

- We will route via PO. Card is not our standard for anything above $25k.
- Procurement needs completed vendor packet, W-9 (or W-8 if non-US), and banking details for ACH (routing + acct).
- We also ask for a sample invoice (PDF) showing line items and billing contact to validate our AP system.
- Marketplace is interesting, but we try to keep enterprise contracts on PO for reporting — happy to revisit later.

Can you send a sample invoice and confirm the exact pay-to name and remit address? Also, does Redwood have a vendor portal / onboarding form we can use, or should we return the packet via email?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Jill and I will prioritize once we have the W-9 and sample invoice.

— Alex
Procurement Manager | Cascade Health
---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Reynolds <alex.reynolds@cascadehealth.com>, Jill Parker <jill.parker@cascadehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, May 30, 2027 at 6:03 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment path — W-9, PO vs card, next steps

Hi Alex / Jill — appreciate the clarity. A few clarifications and the docs you asked for: 

- Pay-to name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit address (for paper checks): 210 Marin St., Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94123
- Sample invoice: attached as a one-line example showing our standard billing descriptor (monthly usage + unit breakdown).
- Vendor portal: we don’t have a universal external portal yet; vendor packets are usually returned by email to invoices@redwood.com or uploaded to the secure intake link below.

Attachments: [Attachment: PO_Instructions.pdf (how to format PO, 80KB)], [Attachment: Sample_Invoice_Redwood.pdf (example invoice, 45KB)]

Next steps: 
- Please send completed vendor packet + PO to invoices@redwood.com and cc Marissa (marissa@redwood.com).
- Marissa will confirm receipt and open the finance ticket to enable vendor in our AP system (5–7 business days typical).
- Ben and I will stand by for any procurement/GL code questions.

If you prefer, Alex, I can also introduce you to our finance contact directly — say the word and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks,
Tessa
---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, May 31, 2027 at 10:18 AM PDT
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding & payment path — W-9, PO vs card, next steps

Thanks team — looping in Finance after I get the packet from Cascade. A couple of items I’ll handle: 

- I’ll create the vendor ticket in our AP system once we have the completed packet and W-9.
- For ACH we need: bank name, account number, routing number, and payee name. I’ll send Cascade a secure upload link for banking docs (to avoid email).
- Ben — can you confirm the GL code and whether we should include product SKUs on the invoice for internal routing? If not, I’ll process as a single line item and tag to SaaS subscriptions.

Tessa — if you can introduce me to Alex via a 1-line intro, I’ll take it from there.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
